name: codedp-bench-canary-mia
description: A benchmark designed to evaluate privacy leakage and membership inference risks in code models by embedding and attempting to recover canary sequences. It measures how easily a model exposes memorized code snippets or secret-like tokens and quantifies attack success under different defenses (e.g., differential privacy).
reputation: A specialized dataset on Hugging Face used by privacy and security researchers studying memorization and membership inference in code models.
